name: Viewport Preview Modal
notes: Implemented full viewport preview modal that opens when clicking the "Open" button on any viewport card. Shows the URL in an iframe at the exact breakpoint width. Includes: toolbar with width/label/URL display, New Tab button, close button, Escape key support, click-outside-to-close, animated open/close transitions, proper sizing based on breakpoint width.

name: Preview Modal Polish

Zero errors.

name: Per-viewport download button on viewport cards
